meta.name: agency-socials
meta.description: Generate social media covers and assets for AGENCY Community events, meetups, and YouTube recordings. Use when creating event covers, YouTube thumbnails, or social posts for the AGENCY Community.

copy.tagline: 生成社区活动社交媒体封面和缩略图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为AGENCY社区活动制作视觉素材
copy.tagline_en: Generate social media covers and assets for community events
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you create visual materials for AGENCY community events

howto.what: 装后，Claude 能根据指定设计系统生成 AGENCY 社区活动的社交媒体封面、YouTube 缩略图和帖子图片。
howto.when: 当你要求为 AGENCY 社区活动创建封面、缩略图或社交帖子时触发。

say.text: 为AGENCY meetup创建一个封面，主题是浏览器自动化。
say.note: Claude会生成符合设计规范的封面图片。

say.text: 为下次社区活动制作Telegram公告图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate social media covers, YouTube thumbnails, and post images for AGENCY Community events using the specified design system.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create covers, thumbnails, or social posts for AGENCY Community events.

say_en.text: Create a cover for the AGENCY meetup about browser automation.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a cover following the design specs.

say_en.text: Generate a YouTube thumbnail for tonight's meetup.
Make a Telegram announcement image for the next community event.
say_en.note: Outputs an image suitable for Telegram.
